R506.note: exec.CommandContext with host as a discrete arg removes the shell; the added 30s timeout is disclosed and reasonable for a 15-hop bounded traceroute.

R507.note: Magic-byte detection via file-type against the same allowlist, random filename with detected-type extension; legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads still succeed.

R508.note: exec(String[]) puts data in its own array element, the standard fix for this sink; behavior (dir/ls listing) is otherwise unchanged.

R510.note: Placeholder + array param via pool.query(); no other observable change.

R512.note: requireAdmin wrapper applied to the export route matching the sibling ban/unban routes; no other behavior change.
